items.source: Class for creating BiFunction callbacks around complete methods with asynchronous support. This class provides a way to convert methods annotated with McpComplete into callback functions that can be used to handle completion requests asynchronously. It supports various method signatures and return types, and handles both prompt and URI template completions.
items.translation: 用于围绕带有异步支持的完整方法创建 BiFunction 回调的类。 该类提供了一种将使用 McpComplete 注解标记的方法转换为可用于异步处理完成请求的回调函数的方法。它支持多种方法签名和返回类型，并处理提示词和 URI 模板的完成操作。
